title: The Casterwill Connection/Quotes
summary:
"America. I never imagined the Casterwills would flee this far."
- Marduk to Kiel

"First floor: senior citizens and Blood Spiral losers. Everyone off!"
- Lok Lambert to the team

"This Seeker stuff is hard work!"
- Den Fears to Dante Vale
